watches.name: Any watch, any strap (or two)!
watches.description: (This is the placeholder product for ordering watches without specifying the straps - to see and directly order the most common straps please select the automatic mechanical or the quartz models.) We offer over 100 different straps from Hirsch and 5 mesh (Milanese) steel straps from Staib - both among the global leaders in their product areas. While we figure out the best way to show and enable ordering of watches with any straps, please order this product, and we will specify the exact straps in an email. The straps are 20mm in width and most have quick release mechanism, so they are easy to change. Exceptions are the mesh straps, for which only the Standard models have quick release mechanisms. Sizing guide by wrist size (approximate): Staib mesh straps: 13.5-20 cm. Hirsch size M: 13.5-19 cm; size L: 14.5-21 cm; size XL (please contact us for availability): 18-23 cm. Straps by price category: Category 1: Toronto, Kansas from Hirsch Category 2: Standard, silky and simple mesh straps from Staib, Kent, Rainbow, Osiris, Osiris Nubuck, Crocograin, Princess, Viazza from Hirsch. Also the Red-white-red straps made exclusively for us by Hirsch Category 3: Duke, Duke metallic, Rally, Diva from Hirsch Category 4: Carbon, Modena, Grand Duke, Merino, Rose from Hirsch Category 5: Andy, Arne, Ascot, Ayrton, Lindsey, George, James, Paul from Hirsch Category 6: Leaf, Gifone, Birch, Serro, Stone from Hirsch Category 7: Sturdy Silver Mesh from Staib
